title: Highlights of Barcelona
text: David, our guide, and Shike, our driver were excellent.  We enjoyed the highlights of Barcelona and ended with the Sagrada Familia.  AMAZING!!!
author: Karen_B

title: Excellent Experience
text:
We had an excellent experience with Xavier. We arrived early in Barcelona so I scheduled a private 4 hour tour around the city after he picked us up from the airport.  We came in even *earlier* than expected!! Xavier was amazing at communicating with me via Whats App even before we got to Barcelona.
